Mr. Speaker, I heard the Minister of Justice last week say that maybe there needs to be a better way of doing this process in the future and he's right, he's absolutely right. There are probably more cost-effective ways. There are probably better ways to engage people. One of the most important ways to get people involved is to actually listen to what they say when you're out there.

Mr. Speaker, with that, I look forward to this going forward. I really hope the Law Amendments Committee goes to the other communities that are affected and wish to see the Law Amendments Committee there. It's not fair to just go to one place and we'll see where this goes. Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
